subject.title: Proposal: model-callable `clear_goal` tool with bounded canonical-store archive

question: Should OpenClaw add a model-callable `clear_goal` tool with canonical `SessionEntry.clearedGoals` retention, or should goal clearing remain operator/session-only?
rationale: Current code and docs deliberately reserve clearing and replacement for operator/session controls, so adding this tool changes model authority over durable session state rather than repairing a broken existing contract.

options.title: Keep operator-only clearing
options.body: Reaffirm the current documented boundary and close or leave this issue as the decision record for why models may complete or block goals but not clear them.

options.title: Approve terminal-only clear_goal
options.body: Allow a v03 PR that clears only approved non-active states, archives atomically in the canonical session entry, and updates docs, tool metadata, tests, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Approve a narrower clear_goal
options.body: Allow only `complete` and `blocked` goals to be cleared by the model while leaving paused and limit states operator-controlled.

recommendation.title: Keep operator-only clearing
recommendation.body: Reaffirm the current documented boundary and close or leave this issue as the decision record for why models may complete or block goals but not clear them.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the session-goals surface this decision would change.
